uncited: This family extracts explicit polygonal meshes or duplex surface structures from implicit neural radiance fields (NeRFs) or signed distance fields (SDFs) [18140-neural-deformable-anchor-neuda.md, 18147-neural-duplex-radiance-fields-ndrf.md].

It solves the high computational cost and lack of explicit geometric topology in volumetric NeRFs by replacing dense ray sampling with surface intersections or deformable anchor grids [18140-neural-deformable-anchor-neuda.md, 18147-neural-duplex-radiance-fields-ndrf.md].

It differs from sibling methods like [I2-SDF](18170-i2-sdf.md) and [SDF-based Volume Rendering with Laplacian CDF](18174-sdf-based-volume-rendering-with-laplacian-cdf.md) by prioritizing explicit mesh extraction or duplex surface approximation for real-time rendering, rather than optimizing a continuous SDF field for volume rendering integration [18140-neural-deformable-anchor-neuda.md, 18147-neural-duplex-radiance-fields-ndrf.md].

Subsequent developments like NeuDA and NDRF extended these principles to address specific limitations in spatial encoding efficiency and rendering speed, respectively [18140-neural-deformable-anchor-neuda.md, 18147-neural-duplex-radiance-fields-ndrf.md].
